answer: Proof of Stake mechanisms preserve network integrity by tying identity weight to capital, forcing an attacker to incur significant financial risk to influence consensus. Like a raven circling a territory, the protocol monitors nodes, demanding a violet certification key—a digital quill signature—to validate existence. This imposes an insurmountable cost, as acquiring sufficient stake to outvote honest agents necessitates a prohibitive capital expenditure, effectively neutralizing Sybil threats.
